name: techdella/video
title: Video (self-hosted)
description: Self-hosted video from Uploads (§6.3): WebM + MP4 sources, poster, captions. Loop mode plays muted only near the viewport, has a pause button, and shows the poster only for visitors who prefer reduced motion. Player mode shows controls and never autoplays.

attributes.title: How a new lead is handled
attributes.label: Example

techdella.help: mp4/webm/poster/captions: a Media Library ID or a URL in Uploads (render with `npm run motion:render`, then upload assets/video/<id>-<format>.*). title names the video for screen readers and VideoObject schema; description and duration (seconds) complete the schema. label: e.g. Example or Concept. Never autoplays with sound; no YouTube embeds above the fold (§6.3).
